Trump Gave Cash Gifts to Aides, Including Natalie Harp

Former U.S. President Donald Trump gave $45,000 in cash gifts to Natalie Harp and two other close aides, according to disclosures. The Washington Post and Politico reported on the gifts, which were holiday gifts. The Independent reported that Harp was with Trump during a Truth Social AI posting spree and was by his side over a weekend following media scrutiny.
